description: This file contains controller functions for handling chat message operations in a server-side application, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and aborting chat messages, as well as parsing responses.

methods.name: getFeedbackTypeFilters
methods.description: Filters feedback types, returning specific feedback types or undefined based on input.

methods.name: createChatMessage
methods.description: Handles creation of a new chat message, calling the chatMessagesService and returning the response.

methods.name: getAllChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all chat messages with filtering, pagination, and sorting options.

methods.name: getAllInternalChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves internal chat messages with specific filtering.

methods.name: removeAllChatMessages
methods.description: Removes all chat messages based on provided filters, with optional session memory clearing.

methods.name: abortChatMessage
methods.description: Aborts a specific chat message based on chatflowid and chatid.

methods.name: parseAPIResponse
methods.description: Parses and converts JSON string fields in chat message responses to objects.
